title: ML Systems Lab: reproducible ML inference benchmarking across heterogeneous hardware
description: A benchmarking framework for ML inference across laptops, single-board computers and servers. One config file and one command produce self-describing JSON records carrying hardware, backend versions, metrics (TTFT, prefill/decode throughput, latency percentiles, memory), and physical telemetry (per-rail power, temperature, throttle state, CPU utilization), plus publication-quality tables and figures. Ships with the real measurements behind an IEEE Transactions on Computers submission and reproduces that paper's roofline fits exactly.
